arabic: بِسمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحمٰنِ الرَّحيمِ قَد أَفلَحَ المُؤمِنونَ
transliteration: Qad aflaha almuminoona
translation: Successful indeed are the believers

arabic: الَّذينَ هُم فى صَلاتِهِم خٰشِعونَ
transliteration: Allatheena hum fee salatihim khashiAAoona
translation: Who are humble in their prayers

arabic: وَالَّذينَ هُم عَنِ اللَّغوِ مُعرِضونَ
transliteration: Waallatheena hum AAani allaghwi muAAridoona
translation: And who shun vain conversation

arabic: وَالَّذينَ هُم لِلزَّكوٰةِ فٰعِلونَ
transliteration: Waallatheena hum lilzzakati faAAiloona
translation: And who are payers of the poor-due

arabic: وَالَّذينَ هُم لِفُروجِهِم حٰفِظونَ
transliteration: Waallatheena hum lifuroojihim hafithoona
translation: And who guard their modesty

arabic: إِلّا عَلىٰ أَزوٰجِهِم أَو ما مَلَكَت أَيمٰنُهُم فَإِنَّهُم غَيرُ مَلومينَ
transliteration: Illa AAala azwajihim aw ma malakat aymanuhum fainnahum ghayru maloomeena
translation: Save from their wives or the (slaves) that their right hands possess, for then they are not blameworthy

arabic: فَمَنِ ابتَغىٰ وَراءَ ذٰلِكَ فَأُولٰئِكَ هُمُ العادونَ
transliteration: Famani ibtagha waraa thalika faolaika humu alAAadoona
translation: But whoso craveth beyond that, such are transgressors

arabic: وَالَّذينَ هُم لِأَمٰنٰتِهِم وَعَهدِهِم رٰعونَ
transliteration: Waallatheena hum liamanatihim waAAahdihim raAAoona
translation: And who are shepherds of their pledge and their covenant

arabic: وَالَّذينَ هُم عَلىٰ صَلَوٰتِهِم يُحافِظونَ
transliteration: Waallatheena hum AAala salawatihim yuhafithoona
translation: And who pay heed to their prayers

arabic: أُولٰئِكَ هُمُ الوٰرِثونَ
transliteration: Olaika humu alwarithoona
translation: These are the heirs

arabic: الَّذينَ يَرِثونَ الفِردَوسَ هُم فيها خٰلِدونَ
transliteration: Allatheena yarithoona alfirdawsa hum feeha khalidoona
translation: Who will inherit paradise. There they will abide

arabic: وَلَقَد خَلَقنَا الإِنسٰنَ مِن سُلٰلَةٍ مِن طينٍ
transliteration: Walaqad khalaqna alinsana min sulalatin min teenin
translation: Verily We created man from a product of wet earth

arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلنٰهُ نُطفَةً فى قَرارٍ مَكينٍ
transliteration: Thumma jaAAalnahu nutfatan fee qararin makeenin
translation: Then placed him as a drop (of seed) in a safe lodging

arabic: ثُمَّ خَلَقنَا النُّطفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقنَا العَلَقَةَ مُضغَةً فَخَلَقنَا المُضغَةَ عِظٰمًا فَكَسَونَا العِظٰمَ لَحمًا ثُمَّ أَنشَأنٰهُ خَلقًا ءاخَرَ فَتَبارَكَ اللَّهُ أَحسَنُ الخٰلِقينَ
transliteration: Thumma khalaqna alnnutfata AAalaqatan fakhalaqna alAAalaqata mudghatan fakhalaqna almudghata AAithaman fakasawna alAAithama lahman thumma anshanahu khalqan akhara fatabaraka Allahu ahsanu alkhaliqeena
translation: Then fashioned We the drop a clot, then fashioned We the clot a little lump, then fashioned We the little lump bones, then clothed the bones with flesh, and then produced it as another creation. So blessed be Allah, the Best of creators

arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعدَ ذٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتونَ
transliteration: Thumma innakum baAAda thalika lamayyitoona
translation: Then lo! after that ye surely die

arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم يَومَ القِيٰمَةِ تُبعَثونَ
transliteration: Thumma innakum yawma alqiyamati tubAAathoona
translation: Then lo! on the Day of Resurrection ye are raised (again)

arabic: وَلَقَد خَلَقنا فَوقَكُم سَبعَ طَرائِقَ وَما كُنّا عَنِ الخَلقِ غٰفِلينَ
transliteration: Walaqad khalaqna fawqakum sabAAa taraiqa wama kunna AAani alkhalqi ghafileena
translation: And We have created above you seven paths, and We are never unmindful of creation

arabic: وَأَنزَلنا مِنَ السَّماءِ ماءً بِقَدَرٍ فَأَسكَنّٰهُ فِى الأَرضِ وَإِنّا عَلىٰ ذَهابٍ بِهِ لَقٰدِرونَ
transliteration: Waanzalna mina alssamai maan biqadarin faaskannahu fee alardi wainna AAala thahabin bihi laqadiroona
translation: And we send down from the sky water in measure, and We give it lodging in the earth, and lo! We are Able to withdraw it

arabic: فَأَنشَأنا لَكُم بِهِ جَنّٰتٍ مِن نَخيلٍ وَأَعنٰبٍ لَكُم فيها فَوٰكِهُ كَثيرَةٌ وَمِنها تَأكُلونَ
transliteration: Faanshana lakum bihi jannatin min nakheelin waaAAnabin lakum feeha fawakihu katheeratun waminha takuloona
translation: Then We produce for you therewith gardens of date-palms and grapes, wherein is much fruit for you and whereof ye eat

arabic: وَشَجَرَةً تَخرُجُ مِن طورِ سَيناءَ تَنبُتُ بِالدُّهنِ وَصِبغٍ لِلءاكِلينَ
transliteration: Washajaratan takhruju min toori saynaa tanbutu bialdduhni wasibghin lilakileena
translation: And a tree that springeth forth from Mount Sinai that groweth oil and relish for the eaters

arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكُم فِى الأَنعٰمِ لَعِبرَةً نُسقيكُم مِمّا فى بُطونِها وَلَكُم فيها مَنٰفِعُ كَثيرَةٌ وَمِنها تَأكُلونَ
transliteration: Wainna lakum fee alanAAami laAAibratan nusqeekum mimma fee butooniha walakum feeha manafiAAu katheeratun waminha takuloona
translation: And lo! in the cattle there is verily a lesson for you. We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies, and many uses have ye in them, and of them do ye eat

arabic: وَعَلَيها وَعَلَى الفُلكِ تُحمَلونَ
transliteration: WaAAalayha waAAala alfulki tuhmaloona
translation: And on them and on the ship ye are carried

arabic: وَلَقَد أَرسَلنا نوحًا إِلىٰ قَومِهِ فَقالَ يٰقَومِ اعبُدُوا اللَّهَ ما لَكُم مِن إِلٰهٍ غَيرُهُ أَفَلا تَتَّقونَ
transliteration: Walaqad arsalna noohan ila qawmihi faqala ya qawmi oAAbudoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu afala tattaqoona
translation: And We verily sent Noah unto his folk, and he said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil)

arabic: فَقالَ المَلَؤُا۟ الَّذينَ كَفَروا مِن قَومِهِ ما هٰذا إِلّا بَشَرٌ مِثلُكُم يُريدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيكُم وَلَو شاءَ اللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلٰئِكَةً ما سَمِعنا بِهٰذا فى ءابائِنَا الأَوَّلينَ
transliteration: Faqala almalao allatheena kafaroo min qawmihi ma hatha illa basharun mithlukum yureedu an yatafaddala AAalaykum walaw shaa Allahu laanzala malaikatan ma samiAAna bihatha fee abaina alawwaleena
translation: But the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved, said: This is only a mortal like you who would make himself superior to you. Had Allah willed, He surely could have sent down angels. We heard not of this in the case of our fathers of old

arabic: إِن هُوَ إِلّا رَجُلٌ بِهِ جِنَّةٌ فَتَرَبَّصوا بِهِ حَتّىٰ حينٍ
transliteration: In huwa illa rajulun bihi jinnatun fatarabbasoo bihi hatta heenin
translation: He is only a man in whom is a madness, so watch him for a while

arabic: قالَ رَبِّ انصُرنى بِما كَذَّبونِ
transliteration: Qala rabbi onsurnee bima kaththabooni
translation: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me

arabic: فَأَوحَينا إِلَيهِ أَنِ اصنَعِ الفُلكَ بِأَعيُنِنا وَوَحيِنا فَإِذا جاءَ أَمرُنا وَفارَ التَّنّورُ فَاسلُك فيها مِن كُلٍّ زَوجَينِ اثنَينِ وَأَهلَكَ إِلّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيهِ القَولُ مِنهُم وَلا تُخٰطِبنى فِى الَّذينَ ظَلَموا إِنَّهُم مُغرَقونَ
transliteration: Faawhayna ilayhi ani isnaAAi alfulka biaAAyunina wawahyina faitha jaa amruna wafara alttannooru faosluk feeha min kullin zawjayni ithnayni waahlaka illa man sabaqa AAalayhi alqawlu minhum wala tukhatibnee fee allatheena thalamoo innahum mughraqoona
translation: Then We inspired in him, saying: Make the ship under Our eyes and Our inspiration. Then, when Our command cometh and the oven gusheth water, introduce therein of every (kind) two spouses, and thy household save him thereof against whom the Word hath already gone forth. And plead not with Me on behalf of those who have done wrong. Lo! they will be drowned

arabic: فَإِذَا استَوَيتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَعَكَ عَلَى الفُلكِ فَقُلِ الحَمدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذى نَجّىٰنا مِنَ القَومِ الظّٰلِمينَ
transliteration: Faitha istawayta anta waman maAAaka AAala alfulki faquli alhamdu lillahi allathee najjana mina alqawmi alththalimeena
translation: And when thou art on board the ship, thou and whoso is with thee, then say: Praise be to Allah Who hath saved us from the wrongdoing folk

arabic: وَقُل رَبِّ أَنزِلنى مُنزَلًا مُبارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيرُ المُنزِلينَ
transliteration: Waqul rabbi anzilnee munzalan mubarakan waanta khayru almunzileena
translation: And say: My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for Thou art Best of all who bring to land

arabic: إِنَّ فى ذٰلِكَ لَءايٰتٍ وَإِن كُنّا لَمُبتَلينَ
transliteration: Inna fee thalika laayatin wain kunna lamubtaleena
translation: Lo! herein verily are portents, for lo! We are ever putting (mankind) to the test

arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأنا مِن بَعدِهِم قَرنًا ءاخَرينَ
transliteration: Thumma anshana min baAAdihim qarnan akhareena
translation: Then, after them, We brought forth another generation

arabic: فَأَرسَلنا فيهِم رَسولًا مِنهُم أَنِ اعبُدُوا اللَّهَ ما لَكُم مِن إِلٰهٍ غَيرُهُ أَفَلا تَتَّقونَ
transliteration: Faarsalna feehim rasoolan minhum ani oAAbudoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu afala tattaqoona
translation: And we sent among them a messenger of their own, saying: Serve Allah, Ye have no other Allah save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil)

arabic: وَقالَ المَلَأُ مِن قَومِهِ الَّذينَ كَفَروا وَكَذَّبوا بِلِقاءِ الءاخِرَةِ وَأَترَفنٰهُم فِى الحَيوٰةِ الدُّنيا ما هٰذا إِلّا بَشَرٌ مِثلُكُم يَأكُلُ مِمّا تَأكُلونَ مِنهُ وَيَشرَبُ مِمّا تَشرَبونَ
transliteration: Waqala almalao min qawmihi allatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biliqai alakhirati waatrafnahum fee alhayati alddunya ma hatha illa basharun mithlukum yakulu mimma takuloona minhu wayashrabu mimma tashraboona
translation: And the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and whom We had made soft in the life of the world, said: This is only a mortal like you, who eateth of that whereof ye eat and drinketh of that ye drink

arabic: وَلَئِن أَطَعتُم بَشَرًا مِثلَكُم إِنَّكُم إِذًا لَخٰسِرونَ
transliteration: Walain ataAAtum basharan mithlakum innakum ithan lakhasiroona
translation: If ye were to obey a mortal like yourselves, then, lo! ye surely would be losers

arabic: أَيَعِدُكُم أَنَّكُم إِذا مِتُّم وَكُنتُم تُرابًا وَعِظٰمًا أَنَّكُم مُخرَجونَ
transliteration: AyaAAidukum annakum itha mittum wakuntum turaban waAAithaman annakum mukhrajoona
translation: Doth he promise you that you, when ye are dead and have become dust and bones, will (again) be brought forth

arabic: هَيهاتَ هَيهاتَ لِما توعَدونَ
transliteration: Hayhata hayhata lima tooAAadoona
translation: Begone, begone, with that which ye are promised

arabic: إِن هِىَ إِلّا حَياتُنَا الدُّنيا نَموتُ وَنَحيا وَما نَحنُ بِمَبعوثينَ
transliteration: In hiya illa hayatuna alddunya namootu wanahya wama nahnu bimabAAootheena
translation: There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and we shall not be raised (again)

arabic: إِن هُوَ إِلّا رَجُلٌ افتَرىٰ عَلَى اللَّهِ كَذِبًا وَما نَحنُ لَهُ بِمُؤمِنينَ
transliteration: In huwa illa rajulun iftara AAala Allahi kathiban wama nahnu lahu bimumineena
translation: He is only a man who hath invented a lie about Allah. We are not going to put faith in him

arabic: قالَ رَبِّ انصُرنى بِما كَذَّبونِ
transliteration: Qala rabbi onsurnee bima kaththabooni
translation: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me

arabic: قالَ عَمّا قَليلٍ لَيُصبِحُنَّ نٰدِمينَ
transliteration: Qala AAamma qaleelin layusbihunna nadimeena
translation: He said: In a little while they surely will become repentant

arabic: فَأَخَذَتهُمُ الصَّيحَةُ بِالحَقِّ فَجَعَلنٰهُم غُثاءً فَبُعدًا لِلقَومِ الظّٰلِمينَ
transliteration: Faakhathathumu alssayhatu bialhaqqi fajaAAalnahum ghuthaan fabuAAdan lilqawmi alththalimeena
translation: So the (Awful) Cry overtook them rightfully, and We made them like as wreckage (that a torrent hurleth). A far removal for wrongdoing folk

arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأنا مِن بَعدِهِم قُرونًا ءاخَرينَ
transliteration: Thumma anshana min baAAdihim quroonan akhareena
translation: Then after them We brought forth other generations

arabic: ما تَسبِقُ مِن أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَها وَما يَستَـٔخِرونَ
transliteration: Ma tasbiqu min ommatin ajalaha wama yastakhiroona
translation: No nation can outstrip its term, nor yet postpone it

arabic: ثُمَّ أَرسَلنا رُسُلَنا تَترا كُلَّ ما جاءَ أُمَّةً رَسولُها كَذَّبوهُ فَأَتبَعنا بَعضَهُم بَعضًا وَجَعَلنٰهُم أَحاديثَ فَبُعدًا لِقَومٍ لا يُؤمِنونَ
transliteration: Thumma arsalna rusulana tatra kulla ma jaa ommatan rasooluha kaththaboohu faatbaAAna baAAdahum baAAdan wajaAAalnahum ahadeetha fabuAAdan liqawmin la yuminoona
translation: Then We sent our messengers one after another. Whenever its messenger came unto a nation they denied him; so We caused them to follow one another (to disaster) and We made them bywords. A far removal for folk who believe not

arabic: ثُمَّ أَرسَلنا موسىٰ وَأَخاهُ هٰرونَ بِـٔايٰتِنا وَسُلطٰنٍ مُبينٍ
transliteration: Thumma arsalna moosa waakhahu haroona biayatina wasultanin mubeenin
translation: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our tokens and a clear warrant

arabic: إِلىٰ فِرعَونَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِ فَاستَكبَروا وَكانوا قَومًا عالينَ
transliteration: Ila firAAawna wamalaihi faistakbaroo wakanoo qawman AAaleena
translation: Unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they scorned (them) and they were despotic folk

arabic: فَقالوا أَنُؤمِنُ لِبَشَرَينِ مِثلِنا وَقَومُهُما لَنا عٰبِدونَ
transliteration: Faqaloo anuminu libasharayni mithlina waqawmuhuma lana AAabidoona
translation: And they said: Shall we put faith in two mortals like ourselves, and whose folk are servile unto us

arabic: فَكَذَّبوهُما فَكانوا مِنَ المُهلَكينَ
transliteration: Fakaththaboohuma fakanoo mina almuhlakeena
translation: So they denied them, and became of those who were destroyed

arabic: وَلَقَد ءاتَينا موسَى الكِتٰبَ لَعَلَّهُم يَهتَدونَ
transliteration: Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba laAAallahum yahtadoona
translation: And We verily gave Moses the Scripture, that haply they might go aright

arabic: وَجَعَلنَا ابنَ مَريَمَ وَأُمَّهُ ءايَةً وَءاوَينٰهُما إِلىٰ رَبوَةٍ ذاتِ قَرارٍ وَمَعينٍ
transliteration: WajaAAalna ibna maryama waommahu ayatan waawaynahuma ila rabwatin thati qararin wamaAAeenin
translation: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a portent, and We gave them refuge on a height, a place of flocks and watersprings

arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا الرُّسُلُ كُلوا مِنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِ وَاعمَلوا صٰلِحًا إِنّى بِما تَعمَلونَ عَليمٌ
transliteration: Ya ayyuha alrrusulu kuloo mina alttayyibati waiAAmaloo salihan innee bima taAAmaloona AAaleemun
translation: O ye messengers! Eat of the good things, and do right. Lo! I am Aware of what ye do

arabic: وَإِنَّ هٰذِهِ أُمَّتُكُم أُمَّةً وٰحِدَةً وَأَنا۠ رَبُّكُم فَاتَّقونِ
transliteration: Wainna hathihi ommatukum ommatan wahidatan waana rabbukum faittaqooni
translation: And lo! this your religion is one religion and I am your Lord, so keep your duty unto Me

arabic: فَتَقَطَّعوا أَمرَهُم بَينَهُم زُبُرًا كُلُّ حِزبٍ بِما لَدَيهِم فَرِحونَ
transliteration: FataqattaAAoo amrahum baynahum zuburan kullu hizbin bima ladayhim farihoona
translation: But they (mankind) have broken their religion among them into sects, each group rejoicing in its tenets

arabic: فَذَرهُم فى غَمرَتِهِم حَتّىٰ حينٍ
transliteration: Fatharhum fee ghamratihim hatta heenin
translation: So leave them in their error till a time

arabic: أَيَحسَبونَ أَنَّما نُمِدُّهُم بِهِ مِن مالٍ وَبَنينَ
transliteration: Ayahsaboona annama numidduhum bihi min malin wabaneena
translation: Think they that in the wealth and sons wherewith We provide them

arabic: نُسارِعُ لَهُم فِى الخَيرٰتِ بَل لا يَشعُرونَ
transliteration: NusariAAu lahum fee alkhayrati bal la yashAAuroona
translation: We hasten unto them with good things? Nay, but they perceive not

arabic: إِنَّ الَّذينَ هُم مِن خَشيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُشفِقونَ
transliteration: Inna allatheena hum min khashyati rabbihim mushfiqoona
translation: Lo! those who go in awe for fear of their Lord

arabic: وَالَّذينَ هُم بِـٔايٰتِ رَبِّهِم يُؤمِنونَ
transliteration: Waallatheena hum biayati rabbihim yuminoona
translation: And those who believe in the revelations of their Lord

arabic: وَالَّذينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِم لا يُشرِكونَ
transliteration: Waallatheena hum birabbihim la yushrikoona
translation: And those who ascribe not partners unto their Lord

arabic: وَالَّذينَ يُؤتونَ ما ءاتَوا وَقُلوبُهُم وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُم إِلىٰ رَبِّهِم رٰجِعونَ
transliteration: Waallatheena yutoona ma ataw waquloobuhum wajilatun annahum ila rabbihim rajiAAoona
translation: And those who give that which they give with hearts afraid because they are about to return unto their Lord

arabic: أُولٰئِكَ يُسٰرِعونَ فِى الخَيرٰتِ وَهُم لَها سٰبِقونَ
transliteration: Olaika yusariAAoona fee alkhayrati wahum laha sabiqoona
translation: These race for the good things, and they shall win them in the race

arabic: وَلا نُكَلِّفُ نَفسًا إِلّا وُسعَها وَلَدَينا كِتٰبٌ يَنطِقُ بِالحَقِّ وَهُم لا يُظلَمونَ
transliteration: Wala nukallifu nafsan illa wusAAaha waladayna kitabun yantiqu bialhaqqi wahum la yuthlamoona
translation: And we task not any soul beyond its scope, and with Us is a Record which speaketh the truth, and they will not be wronged

arabic: بَل قُلوبُهُم فى غَمرَةٍ مِن هٰذا وَلَهُم أَعمٰلٌ مِن دونِ ذٰلِكَ هُم لَها عٰمِلونَ
transliteration: Bal quloobuhum fee ghamratin min hatha walahum aAAmalun min dooni thalika hum laha AAamiloona
translation: Nay, but their hearts are in ignorance of this (Qur'an), and they have other works, besides, which they are doing

arabic: حَتّىٰ إِذا أَخَذنا مُترَفيهِم بِالعَذابِ إِذا هُم يَجـَٔرونَ
transliteration: Hatta itha akhathna mutrafeehim bialAAathabi itha hum yajaroona
translation: Till when We grasp their luxurious ones with the punishment, behold! they supplicate

arabic: لا تَجـَٔرُوا اليَومَ إِنَّكُم مِنّا لا تُنصَرونَ
transliteration: La tajaroo alyawma innakum minna la tunsaroona
translation: Supplicate not this day! Assuredly ye will not be helped by Us

arabic: قَد كانَت ءايٰتى تُتلىٰ عَلَيكُم فَكُنتُم عَلىٰ أَعقٰبِكُم تَنكِصونَ
transliteration: Qad kanat ayatee tutla AAalaykum fakuntum AAala aAAqabikum tankisoona
translation: My revelations were recited unto you, but ye used to turn back on your heels

arabic: مُستَكبِرينَ بِهِ سٰمِرًا تَهجُرونَ
transliteration: Mustakbireena bihi samiran tahjuroona
translation: In scorn thereof. Nightly did ye rave together

arabic: أَفَلَم يَدَّبَّرُوا القَولَ أَم جاءَهُم ما لَم يَأتِ ءاباءَهُمُ الأَوَّلينَ
transliteration: Afalam yaddabbaroo alqawla am jaahum ma lam yati abaahumu alawwaleena
translation: Have they not pondered the Word, or hath that come unto them which came not unto their fathers of old

arabic: أَم لَم يَعرِفوا رَسولَهُم فَهُم لَهُ مُنكِرونَ
transliteration: Am lam yaAArifoo rasoolahum fahum lahu munkiroona
translation: Or know they not their messenger, and so reject him

arabic: أَم يَقولونَ بِهِ جِنَّةٌ بَل جاءَهُم بِالحَقِّ وَأَكثَرُهُم لِلحَقِّ كٰرِهونَ
transliteration: Am yaqooloona bihi jinnatun bal jaahum bialhaqqi waaktharuhum lilhaqqi karihoona
translation: Or say they: There is a madness in him? Nay, but he bringeth them the Truth; and most of them are haters of the Truth

arabic: وَلَوِ اتَّبَعَ الحَقُّ أَهواءَهُم لَفَسَدَتِ السَّمٰوٰتُ وَالأَرضُ وَمَن فيهِنَّ بَل أَتَينٰهُم بِذِكرِهِم فَهُم عَن ذِكرِهِم مُعرِضونَ
transliteration: Walawi ittabaAAa alhaqqu ahwaahum lafasadati alssamawatu waalardu waman feehinna bal ataynahum bithikrihim fahum AAan thikrihim muAAridoona
translation: And if the Truth had followed their desires, verily the heavens and the earth and whosoever is therein had been corrupted. Nay, We have brought them their Reminder, but from their Reminder they now turn away

arabic: أَم تَسـَٔلُهُم خَرجًا فَخَراجُ رَبِّكَ خَيرٌ وَهُوَ خَيرُ الرّٰزِقينَ
transliteration: Am tasaluhum kharjan fakharaju rabbika khayrun wahuwa khayru alrraziqeena
translation: Or dost thou ask of them (O Muhammad) any tribute? But the bounty of thy Lord is better, for He is Best of all who make provision

arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدعوهُم إِلىٰ صِرٰطٍ مُستَقيمٍ
transliteration: Wainnaka latadAAoohum ila siratin mustaqeemin
translation: And lo! thou summonest them indeed unto a straight path

arabic: وَإِنَّ الَّذينَ لا يُؤمِنونَ بِالءاخِرَةِ عَنِ الصِّرٰطِ لَنٰكِبونَ
transliteration: Wainna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati AAani alssirati lanakiboona
translation: And lo! those who believe not in the Hereafter are indeed astray from the path

arabic: وَلَو رَحِمنٰهُم وَكَشَفنا ما بِهِم مِن ضُرٍّ لَلَجّوا فى طُغيٰنِهِم يَعمَهونَ
transliteration: Walaw rahimnahum wakashafna ma bihim min durrin lalajjoo fee tughyanihim yaAAmahoona
translation: Though We had mercy on them and relieved them of the harm afflicting them, they still would wander blindly on in their contumacy

arabic: وَلَقَد أَخَذنٰهُم بِالعَذابِ فَمَا استَكانوا لِرَبِّهِم وَما يَتَضَرَّعونَ
transliteration: Walaqad akhathnahum bialAAathabi fama istakanoo lirabbihim wama yatadarraAAoona
translation: Already have We grasped them with punishment, but they humble not themselves unto their Lord, nor do they pray

arabic: حَتّىٰ إِذا فَتَحنا عَلَيهِم بابًا ذا عَذابٍ شَديدٍ إِذا هُم فيهِ مُبلِسونَ
transliteration: Hatta itha fatahna AAalayhim baban tha AAathabin shadeedin itha hum feehi mublisoona
translation: Until, when We open for them the gate of extreme punishment, behold! they are aghast thereat

arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذى أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ السَّمعَ وَالأَبصٰرَ وَالأَفـِٔدَةَ قَليلًا ما تَشكُرونَ
transliteration: Wahuwa allathee anshaa lakumu alssamAAa waalabsara waalafidata qaleelan ma tashkuroona
translation: He it is Who hath created for you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye

arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذى ذَرَأَكُم فِى الأَرضِ وَإِلَيهِ تُحشَرونَ
transliteration: Wahuwa allathee tharaakum fee alardi wailayhi tuhsharoona
translation: And He it is Who hath sown you broadcast in the earth, and unto Him ye will be gathered

arabic: وَهُوَ الَّذى يُحيۦ وَيُميتُ وَلَهُ اختِلٰفُ الَّيلِ وَالنَّهارِ أَفَلا تَعقِلونَ
transliteration: Wahuwa allathee yuhyee wayumeetu walahu ikhtilafu allayli waalnnahari afala taAAqiloona
translation: And He it is Who giveth life and causeth death, and His is the difference of night and day. Have ye then no sense

arabic: بَل قالوا مِثلَ ما قالَ الأَوَّلونَ
transliteration: Bal qaloo mithla ma qala alawwaloona
translation: Nay, but they say the like of that which said the men of old

arabic: قالوا أَءِذا مِتنا وَكُنّا تُرابًا وَعِظٰمًا أَءِنّا لَمَبعوثونَ
transliteration: Qaloo aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamabAAoothoona
translation: They say: When we are dead and have become (mere) dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again

arabic: لَقَد وُعِدنا نَحنُ وَءاباؤُنا هٰذا مِن قَبلُ إِن هٰذا إِلّا أَسٰطيرُ الأَوَّلينَ
transliteration: Laqad wuAAidna nahnu waabaona hatha min qablu in hatha illa asateeru alawwaleena
translation: We were already promised this, we and our forefathers. Lo! this is naught but fables of the men of old

arabic: قُل لِمَنِ الأَرضُ وَمَن فيها إِن كُنتُم تَعلَمونَ
transliteration: Qul limani alardu waman feeha in kuntum taAAlamoona
translation: Say: Unto Whom (belongeth) the earth and whosoever is therein, if ye have knowledge

arabic: سَيَقولونَ لِلَّهِ قُل أَفَلا تَذَكَّرونَ
transliteration: Sayaqooloona lillahi qul afala tathakkaroona
translation: They will say: Unto Allah. Say: Will ye not then remember

arabic: قُل مَن رَبُّ السَّمٰوٰتِ السَّبعِ وَرَبُّ العَرشِ العَظيمِ
transliteration: Qul man rabbu alssamawati alssabAAi warabbu alAAarshi alAAatheemi
translation: Say: Who is Lord of the seven heavens, and Lord of the Tremendous Throne

arabic: سَيَقولونَ لِلَّهِ قُل أَفَلا تَتَّقونَ
transliteration: Sayaqooloona lillahi qul afala tattaqoona
translation: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: Will ye not then keep duty (unto Him)

arabic: قُل مَن بِيَدِهِ مَلَكوتُ كُلِّ شَيءٍ وَهُوَ يُجيرُ وَلا يُجارُ عَلَيهِ إِن كُنتُم تَعلَمونَ
transliteration: Qul man biyadihi malakootu kulli shayin wahuwa yujeeru wala yujaru AAalayhi in kuntum taAAlamoona
translation: Say: In Whose hand is the dominion over all things and He protecteth, while against Him there is no protection, if ye have knowledge

arabic: سَيَقولونَ لِلَّهِ قُل فَأَنّىٰ تُسحَرونَ
transliteration: Sayaqooloona lillahi qul faanna tusharoona
translation: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: How then are ye bewitched

arabic: بَل أَتَينٰهُم بِالحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُم لَكٰذِبونَ
transliteration: Bal ataynahum bialhaqqi wainnahum lakathiboona
translation: Nay, but We have brought them the Truth, and lo! they are liars

arabic: مَا اتَّخَذَ اللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٍ وَما كانَ مَعَهُ مِن إِلٰهٍ إِذًا لَذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلٰهٍ بِما خَلَقَ وَلَعَلا بَعضُهُم عَلىٰ بَعضٍ سُبحٰنَ اللَّهِ عَمّا يَصِفونَ
transliteration: Ma ittakhatha Allahu min waladin wama kana maAAahu min ilahin ithan lathahaba kullu ilahin bima khalaqa walaAAala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin subhana Allahi AAamma yasifoona
translation: Allah hath not chosen any son, nor is there any god along with Him; else would each god have assuredly championed that which he created, and some of them would assuredly have overcome others. Glorified be Allah above all that they allege

arabic: عٰلِمِ الغَيبِ وَالشَّهٰدَةِ فَتَعٰلىٰ عَمّا يُشرِكونَ
transliteration: AAalimi alghaybi waalshshahadati fataAAala AAamma yushrikoona
translation: Knower of the Invisible and the Visible! and Exalted be He over all that they ascribe as partners (unto Him)

arabic: قُل رَبِّ إِمّا تُرِيَنّى ما يوعَدونَ
transliteration: Qul rabbi imma turiyannee ma yooAAadoona
translation: Say: My Lord! If Thou shouldst show me that which they are promised

arabic: رَبِّ فَلا تَجعَلنى فِى القَومِ الظّٰلِمينَ
transliteration: Rabbi fala tajAAalnee fee alqawmi alththalimeena
translation: My Lord! then set me not among the wrongdoing folk

arabic: وَإِنّا عَلىٰ أَن نُرِيَكَ ما نَعِدُهُم لَقٰدِرونَ
transliteration: Wainna AAala an nuriyaka ma naAAiduhum laqadiroona
translation: And verily We are Able to show thee that which We have promised them

arabic: ادفَع بِالَّتى هِىَ أَحسَنُ السَّيِّئَةَ نَحنُ أَعلَمُ بِما يَصِفونَ
transliteration: IdfaAA biallatee hiya ahsanu alssayyiata nahnu aAAlamu bima yasifoona
translation: Repel evil with that which is better. We are Best Aware of that which they allege

arabic: وَقُل رَبِّ أَعوذُ بِكَ مِن هَمَزٰتِ الشَّيٰطينِ
transliteration: Waqul rabbi aAAoothu bika min hamazati alshshayateeni
translation: And say: My Lord! I seek refuge in Thee from suggestions of the evil ones

arabic: وَأَعوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحضُرونِ
transliteration: WaaAAoothu bika rabbi an yahdurooni
translation: And I seek refuge in Thee, my Lord, lest they be present with me

arabic: حَتّىٰ إِذا جاءَ أَحَدَهُمُ المَوتُ قالَ رَبِّ ارجِعونِ
transliteration: Hatta itha jaa ahadahumu almawtu qala rabbi irjiAAooni
translation: Until, when death cometh unto one of them, he saith: My Lord! Send me back

arabic: لَعَلّى أَعمَلُ صٰلِحًا فيما تَرَكتُ كَلّا إِنَّها كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قائِلُها وَمِن وَرائِهِم بَرزَخٌ إِلىٰ يَومِ يُبعَثونَ
transliteration: LaAAallee aAAmalu salihan feema taraktu kalla innaha kalimatun huwa qailuha wamin waraihim barzakhun ila yawmi yubAAathoona
translation: That I may do right in that which I have left behind! But nay! It is but a word that he speaketh; and behind them is a barrier until the day when they are raised

arabic: فَإِذا نُفِخَ فِى الصّورِ فَلا أَنسابَ بَينَهُم يَومَئِذٍ وَلا يَتَساءَلونَ
transliteration: Faitha nufikha fee alssoori fala ansaba baynahum yawmaithin wala yatasaaloona
translation: And when the trumpet is blown there will be no kinship among them that day, nor will they ask of one another

arabic: فَمَن ثَقُلَت مَوٰزينُهُ فَأُولٰئِكَ هُمُ المُفلِحونَ
transliteration: Faman thaqulat mawazeenuhu faolaika humu almuflihoona
translation: Then those whose scales are heavy, they are the successful

arabic: وَمَن خَفَّت مَوٰزينُهُ فَأُولٰئِكَ الَّذينَ خَسِروا أَنفُسَهُم فى جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدونَ
transliteration: Waman khaffat mawazeenuhu faolaika allatheena khasiroo anfusahum fee jahannama khalidoona
translation: And those whose scales are light are those who lose their souls, in hell abiding

arabic: تَلفَحُ وُجوهَهُمُ النّارُ وَهُم فيها كٰلِحونَ
transliteration: Talfahu wujoohahumu alnnaru wahum feeha kalihoona
translation: The fire burneth their faces, and they are glum therein

arabic: أَلَم تَكُن ءايٰتى تُتلىٰ عَلَيكُم فَكُنتُم بِها تُكَذِّبونَ
transliteration: Alam takun ayatee tutla AAalaykum fakuntum biha tukaththiboona
translation: (It will be said): Were not My revelations recited unto you, and then ye used to deny them

arabic: قالوا رَبَّنا غَلَبَت عَلَينا شِقوَتُنا وَكُنّا قَومًا ضالّينَ
transliteration: Qaloo rabbana ghalabat AAalayna shiqwatuna wakunna qawman dalleena
translation: They will say: Our Lord! Our evil fortune conquered us, and we were erring folk

arabic: رَبَّنا أَخرِجنا مِنها فَإِن عُدنا فَإِنّا ظٰلِمونَ
transliteration: Rabbana akhrijna minha fain AAudna fainna thalimoona
translation: Our Lord! Oh, bring us forth from hence! If we return (to evil) then indeed we shall be wrong-doers

arabic: قالَ اخسَـٔوا فيها وَلا تُكَلِّمونِ
transliteration: Qala ikhsaoo feeha wala tukallimooni
translation: He saith: Begone therein, and speak not unto Me

arabic: إِنَّهُ كانَ فَريقٌ مِن عِبادى يَقولونَ رَبَّنا ءامَنّا فَاغفِر لَنا وَارحَمنا وَأَنتَ خَيرُ الرّٰحِمينَ
transliteration: Innahu kana fareequn min AAibadee yaqooloona rabbana amanna faighfir lana wairhamna waanta khayru alrrahimeena
translation: Lo! there was a party of My slaves who said: Our Lord! We believe, therefor forgive us and have mercy on us for Thou art Best of all who show mercy

arabic: فَاتَّخَذتُموهُم سِخرِيًّا حَتّىٰ أَنسَوكُم ذِكرى وَكُنتُم مِنهُم تَضحَكونَ
transliteration: Faittakhathtumoohum sikhriyyan hatta ansawkum thikree wakuntum minhum tadhakoona
translation: But ye chose them for a laughing-stock until they caused you to forget remembrance of Me, while ye laughed at them

arabic: إِنّى جَزَيتُهُمُ اليَومَ بِما صَبَروا أَنَّهُم هُمُ الفائِزونَ
transliteration: Innee jazaytuhumu alyawma bima sabaroo annahum humu alfaizoona
translation: Lo! I have rewarded them this day forasmuch as they were steadfast in that they, even they, are the triumphant

arabic: قٰلَ كَم لَبِثتُم فِى الأَرضِ عَدَدَ سِنينَ
transliteration: Qala kam labithtum fee alardi AAadada sineena
translation: He will say: How long tarried ye in the earth, counting by years

arabic: قالوا لَبِثنا يَومًا أَو بَعضَ يَومٍ فَسـَٔلِ العادّينَ
transliteration: Qaloo labithna yawman aw baAAda yawmin faisali alAAaddeena
translation: They will say: We tarried by a day or part of a day. Ask of those who keep count

arabic: قٰلَ إِن لَبِثتُم إِلّا قَليلًا لَو أَنَّكُم كُنتُم تَعلَمونَ
transliteration: Qala in labithtum illa qaleelan law annakum kuntum taAAlamoona
translation: He will say: Ye tarried but a little if ye only knew

arabic: أَفَحَسِبتُم أَنَّما خَلَقنٰكُم عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُم إِلَينا لا تُرجَعونَ
transliteration: Afahasibtum annama khalaqnakum AAabathan waannakum ilayna la turjaAAoona
translation: Deemed ye then that We had created you for naught, and that ye would not be returned unto Us

arabic: فَتَعٰلَى اللَّهُ المَلِكُ الحَقُّ لا إِلٰهَ إِلّا هُوَ رَبُّ العَرشِ الكَريمِ
transliteration: FataAAala Allahu almaliku alhaqqu la ilaha illa huwa rabbu alAAarshi alkareemi
translation: Now Allah be Exalted, the True King! There is no Allah save Him, the Lord of the Throne of Grace

arabic: وَمَن يَدعُ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلٰهًا ءاخَرَ لا بُرهٰنَ لَهُ بِهِ فَإِنَّما حِسابُهُ عِندَ رَبِّهِ إِنَّهُ لا يُفلِحُ الكٰفِرونَ
transliteration: Waman yadAAu maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara la burhana lahu bihi fainnama hisabuhu AAinda rabbihi innahu la yuflihu alkafiroona
translation: He who crieth unto any other god along with Allah hath no proof thereof. His reckoning is only with his Lord. Lo! disbelievers will not be successful

arabic: وَقُل رَبِّ اغفِر وَارحَم وَأَنتَ خَيرُ الرّٰحِمينَ
transliteration: Waqul rabbi ighfir wairham waanta khayru alrrahimeena
translation: And (O Muhammad) say: My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for Thou art Best of all who show mercy
